description: 東京駅周辺屋内地図オープンデータ(令和元年度版) [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 政策統括官. 最新版のデータは下記にて公開しています。 「東京駅周辺屋内地図オープンデータ（令和2年度更新版）」 URL: geospatial. jp/ckan/dataset/edit/mlit-indoor-tokyo-r2 国土交通省が実施している、「高精度測位社会プロジェクト」の実証実験... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 政策統括官. Its tags are 不動産建設経済局, 中央区, 二重橋前駅, 千代田区, 地理空間情報活用推進基本計画. It offers 8 resource(s) in jpeg, pdf, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use (compatible with CC-BY-4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
